summary: Tested the new DHARA Advocate Consultation Notetaker (Phase 1): backend /api/notetaker/* (28/28 pytest cases passed) and all 4 new frontend screens (matter detail, new-consultation form, consultation workspace state machine) end-to-end via Playwright on mobile viewport (375x667), logged in as voicetest2026@example.com. Covered manual-notes path (consent -> notes -> Claude Sonnet 5.5 generation -> edit -> approve -> export/copy -> task drafts), transcript-import path (consent -> paste transcript -> import -> edit -> approve -> note draft), audio-upload path (upload via API confirmed 200 + AUDIO_REVIEW screen renders correctly), and the cancel flow. Found and FIXED one real (not test-tooling) bug: the Approve-note and Cancel-consultation confirm dialogs used React Native's raw Alert.alert with multiple buttons, which the codebase's own crossAlert.ts utility documents as silently non-functional on react-native-web (no buttons render, callback never fires) -- this completely blocked the Approve and Cancel flows on web before the fix. Swapped both call sites to the existing crossAlert() utility (same pattern already used elsewhere in the app); retested and both flows now work correctly on web.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED DURING THIS SESSION: both used RN's Alert.alert(title, message, [cancelBtn, confirmBtn]) directly. On react-native-web, multi-button Alert.alert renders nothing and never calls back -- 'Approve & finalise note' and 'Cancel' buttons were completely inert on the web preview (no visible error, state never changed). Swapped both to the pre-existing src/utils/crossAlert.ts helper (used elsewhere in the app for exactly this reason). Verified via Playwright: Approve now transitions NOTE_DRAFT->APPROVED and shows the banner; Cancel now transitions to CANCELLED and shows the terminal screen.
ui_bugs.testID: n/a - no testID on these Pressables

ui_bugs.issue: Minor cosmetic: uploaded file size is displayed only in MB with one decimal (e.g. a 16KB test file showed '0.0 MB'). Not blocking, just imprecise for small files.

react_native_issues.component: All Notetaker step components (ApprovedStep, AudioStep, ConsentStep, InputStep, TranscriptStep, consultation/new.tsx, notetaker/index.tsx)
react_native_issues.issue: These still use raw Alert.alert for single-button error/info toasts. Per the app's own crossAlert.ts documentation, single-button Alert.alert calls do fall back to window.alert() reliably on web, so these were not blocking -- but for consistency, the main agent may want to migrate all Notetaker Alert.alert calls to crossAlert in a follow-up pass.

action_items: No remaining blocking issues found. Optionally: migrate the remaining single-button Alert.alert calls in Notetaker step files to crossAlert for consistency (low priority, not currently broken).
Optionally improve audio file size display to show KB for files under 1MB.

Did not fully exercise the Whisper transcription completion step (PROCESSING -> TRANSCRIPT_REVIEW) end-to-end in the UI due to time/flakiness constraints per instructions -- confirmed via API that audio upload succeeds and transitions to AUDIO_REVIEW, and confirmed AudioStep UI renders correctly with 'Start transcription' button. The actual Whisper call itself (triggered by /audio/transcribe) was not invoked in this session.
critical_code_review_comments: advocate_notetaker_router.py is clean, well-documented, and all state-transition guards (403/404/409/400) matched expectations in every test.
notetaker/api.ts, ui.tsx and all step components are well-structured, properly typed, and consistently use the ownership-scoped backend endpoints.

The Alert.alert vs crossAlert inconsistency found here suggests this is a recurring risk pattern across the codebase when new screens are added without referencing crossAlert.ts -- consider a lint rule or code review checklist item banning direct multi-button Alert.alert imports outside crossAlert.ts itself.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Notetaker Phase 1 frontend+backend is functionally complete and verified end-to-end for manual-notes and transcript-import paths, plus audio-upload (backend call verified, UI screen verified, Whisper completion itself not exercised). The one real bug found (Alert.alert vs crossAlert breaking Approve/Cancel on web) has been fixed in this session -- if a future agent sees Approve or Cancel silently do nothing again in any OTHER new screen, check for the same raw-Alert.alert-with-multiple-buttons pattern first per the RCA below.
rca_of_issue: React-native-web's Alert.alert implementation (via the polyfill shipped with this app) only reliably renders a plain window.alert() for single-button calls; when given a buttons array with more than one entry (e.g. ['Keep working'/'Cancel consultation'] or ['Not yet'/'Approve']), it renders nothing and never invokes any callback -- confirmed this directly: clicking 'Approve & finalise note' and 'Cancel' had zero effect (no modal appeared, no network call fired, state stayed unchanged) until the call sites were switched to the app's own crossAlert() utility (frontend/src/utils/crossAlert.ts), which falls back to window.confirm()/window.alert() on web and real Alert.alert on native. After the fix, both flows worked correctly in Playwright (NOTE_DRAFT->APPROVED and the various states ->CANCELLED, verified via screenshot and backend GET).
